title: Remove ElevenLabs AudioNative from Anth.us pages

comments.author: home
comments.text: Removed the site-wide AudioNative injection from article pages and removed its shortcode wiring from platform-product pages; deleted both unused ElevenLabs AudioNative component implementations. Content scan found no remaining page-authored embeds. Gatsby production build completed and all page HTML plus JS bundles referenced from generated HTML are free of AudioNative.
